terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.seoDescription: Read the ConvoTalk terms of use. Rules, responsibilities and conditions for using the platform.
terms.s1Before: Your privacy is a priority at ConvoTalk. Your personal data is processed in accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018 - LGPD). Full details about the collection, use and protection of your information are described in our

terms.s3Text2: You are solely responsible for the content you publish and for compliance with applicable law.

terms.s5Text: ConvoTalk is provided "as is", without warranties of continuous availability, freedom from errors or fitness for specific purposes. We do not guarantee the delivery, integrity or availability of messages, calls or files transmitted through the service.
terms.s6Text: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, ConvoTalk shall not be liable for direct, indirect, incidental or consequential damages arising from the use or inability to use the service, including data loss, communication interruptions, offensive content sent by other users or losses resulting from audio or video calls.
terms.s7Text: ConvoTalk reserves the right to modify these Terms at any time. We will notify users of significant changes through the platform itself or by email at least 30 days before the new conditions take effect.
terms.s8Text: You may close your account at any time on the Settings page using the "Delete my account" option. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms or applicable law, with or without prior notice.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.seoDescription: Learn about ConvoTalk's privacy policy. How we collect, use and protect your personal data.
privacy.s1Text: This Privacy Policy describes how ConvoTalk collects, uses, stores and protects its users' personal data in accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018 - LGPD) and other applicable laws. By using the service, you acknowledge and agree to the practices described here.
privacy.s2Intro: We collect only the minimum necessary to provide our services. Transparency is essential to us:
storedItems: Name, email and (encrypted) password from registration.
Profile photo, status and notification preferences.
Content of messages and files sent.
Activity data: last access, online presence and IP address for security purposes.
notStoredItems: No browsing, contacts or social media data.
No financial or government identification data.
privacy.s3Intro: We use your personal data for the following purposes:
s3Items: Providing and operating the messaging service;
Account authentication and security, including email verification and password reset;
Storage and transmission of messages, files and calls;
Continuous improvement of the service and prevention of fraud and abuse;
Compliance with legal and regulatory obligations.
privacy.s4Intro: ConvoTalk's data processing is based on the following legal bases under the LGPD:
s4Items: Consent (Art. 7, I): for processing profile and preference data;
Performance of a contract (Art. 7, V): for providing the service agreed upon when creating the account;
Legitimate interest (Art. 7, IX): for security, fraud prevention and service improvement;
Compliance with a legal obligation (Art. 7, II): where applicable.
privacy.s5Text1: ConvoTalk does not sell, rent or trade personal data. Your data may be shared only with service providers essential to the platform's operation, acting as processors under our instructions:
s5Items: Cloudinary: hosting of uploaded images and files;
Resend: sending transactional emails (verification and password reset);
Google STUN server: facilitating peer-to-peer audio and video calls.
privacy.s5Text2: Some of these providers may be located outside Brazil, which involves an international data transfer carried out in accordance with Art. 33 of the LGPD and appropriate security guarantees.
privacy.s6Text1: We use only one functional cookie strictly necessary for session authentication (the refresh_token cookie, HTTP-only and encrypted in production). We do not use tracking, advertising or third-party behavioral analytics cookies.
privacy.s6Text2: We also use browser local storage (localStorage and IndexedDB) to keep your session, theme and notification preferences and an offline queue of pending messages. This data remains on your device and is not sent to third parties.
privacy.s7Text1: Your data is kept for the period necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy or while your account is active. Messages and files are retained until account deletion or individual deletion by the user.
privacy.s7Text2: Audit logs containing IP addresses are kept exclusively for security, fraud prevention and legal compliance purposes.
privacy.s8Intro: In accordance with the LGPD, you have the right to:
s8Items: Confirm that your data is being processed (Art. 18, I).
Correct incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data (Art. 18, III).
Request portability of data to another provider (Art. 18, V).
Request deletion of data processed based on consent (Art. 18, VI).
Request information about data sharing (Art. 18, VII).
privacy.s8Text: You can exercise most of these rights directly in the service through account settings, including profile editing and account deletion. For other requests, contact us using the email indicated in the contact section.
privacy.s9Text: We adopt appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration or destruction, including: passwords stored with secure hashing (bcrypt), authentication using short-lived JWT tokens and HTTP-only cookies, encrypted communication via HTTPS and rate limiting on sensitive endpoints to prevent brute-force attacks.
privacy.s10Text: ConvoTalk is intended for people aged 18 or older. We do not intentionally collect personal data from minors. If we learn that a person under 18 has created an account, we will delete the data immediately.
privacy.s11Text: Under Art. 41 of the LGPD, ConvoTalk provides a Data Protection Officer to handle matters related to the processing of personal data. The DPO's contact is the same channel indicated in the contact section of this policy.
privacy.s12Text: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically. Relevant changes will be communicated through the service itself or by the registered email. The last updated date is indicated at the top of this page.
privacy.s13Text1: To exercise your rights, clarify doubts or submit requests related to privacy and data processing, contact us using the support email provided on the home page or in the settings menu.
privacy.s13Text2: You may also contact the Brazilian National Data Protection Authority (ANPD) in the event of any failure to comply with the LGPD.
